column1: # Author aliases for preset names: alias<TAB>canonical, both case-folded.
# A canonical of `a + b` credits several people; `unknown` marks a title fragment that sits
# where an author would (the whole name then has an unknown author).
# Hand-checked against the cream-of-the-crop pack; only spellings clearly of one person.
# `Esotic & Rozzer` and `Rozzor & Esotic` are the same pair
# Idiot24-7 also signs as Idiot (`Pinbi7 & Idiot`, `Rovastar & Idiot24-7`)
# DemonLD: `Demon Lord + Flexi - Future dominanta` is `DemonLD_-_Future_domination`
# Phat's joint credits written with an underscore
# AdamFX's house names in the author slot, with the original author where it is named
new creation sensation ft adamfx amandio c n martin
milk king to the extreemfx flexi
